name: MEOW-BOT
description: MEOW-BOT - a modular WhatsApp bot built with Node.js and Baileys.

SESSION_ID.description: Your MEOW-BOT session ID (kept private - never share it).

SESSION_URL.description: Session generator URL, only if you use your own generator.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner phone number with country code, digits only (comma separate several for sudo users).

PREFIX.description: Command prefix. Use several characters for several prefixes, or null for none.

MODE.description: public = everyone can use the bot, private = owner only.

BOT_LANG.description: Bot reply language: english or manglish (can also be changed with .lang)
